note: Setup runs against a machine's real state, so eval fixtures simulate it: each scenario file is a transcript of what the prerequisite commands printed. The agent must report from that evidence — the assertions test honest checklisting, not tool installation.

evals.name: healthy-except-gh
evals.prompt: Set up pi-tasks for my vault at ~/vault. I already ran the prerequisite checks — the commands and their output are in scenario.txt. Tell me where I stand and what's left to do.
evals.expected_output: A per-prerequisite checklist quoting the evidence: pi, npx/difit, git vault, and plugin files pass; gh auth failed but is reported as a limitation (no PR/issue tracking) rather than a blocker; enabling under Community plugins is left to the user to confirm, not claimed.
assertions: Reports a checklist with one line per prerequisite (pi, node/npx or difit, gh, vault git, plugin files)
Every passed line cites the command output from the scenario, not an assumption
gh auth failure is reported as limiting PR/issue tracking, not as blocking setup
Does not claim the plugin is enabled in Community plugins — tells the user to check that step themselves
Includes the exact gh fix (gh auth login) rather than a vague 'fix gh'

evals.name: bare-pi-no-provider
evals.prompt: I installed pi and the pi-tasks plugin but agents never respond. Diagnostics output is in scenario.txt. What's wrong?
evals.expected_output: Identifies that pi --version passing while no provider/API key is configured is the failure; setup is NOT complete; gives the exact fix (run pi once to configure a provider / set the API key).
assertions: Identifies the missing provider/API key as the cause, despite pi --version succeeding
Does not call setup complete or mostly-working while the provider check fails
Gives a concrete fix: configure a provider or API key via pi, not a generic reinstall suggestion

evals.name: plugin-files-missing
evals.prompt: Finish setting up pi-tasks — check state per scenario.txt (my vault is /home/me/vault). The plugin repo is checked out at /home/me/src/skills-n-stuff/obsidian-pi-tasks.
evals.expected_output: Everything passes except the plugin files are absent from .obsidian/plugins/pi-tasks/; the response builds (npm install && npm run build) and copies manifest.json, main.js, styles.css, then re-verifies before reporting done — or, if it cannot execute, gives exactly those steps and does not claim completion.
assertions: Detects that manifest.json/main.js/styles.css are missing from the vault's plugin folder
Fix is build-and-copy of the three files (npm install, npm run build, cp), with the correct destination path under .obsidian/plugins/pi-tasks/
Does not report setup complete without the copy step having been done and re-verified (or explicitly handed to the user as remaining work)
Vault git check passing is cited from the scenario evidence
